newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens higher, financials active.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens higher, financials active.

text.p: UK shares opened mixed to higher on Monday, helped by a firm financials sector after Alliance & Leicester made a strong market debut which surpassed most analysts expectations.
The FTSE 100 index was up just 0.9 points at 4,311.4 by 0745 GMT but banking stocks were firm in active trade. Gainers outweighed losers by roughly five-to-four.
Shares in newly floated bank Alliance & Leicester began trading at 542.5p/shr before climbing as high as 556p in rapid early trade.
Institutional investors had already had a chance to purchase the new stock following an auction last Friday which resulted in an average price of 522 pence per share.
